methods.label: Unwrap the logarithms
methods.explanation:
The definition of a logarithm lets us undo the nesting from the outside inward. First, the logarithms require \(x>0\), \(\log_2x>0\), and \(\log_3(\log_2x)>0\). Together these conditions mean \(x>2\).

Using \(\log_a b=c\) to mean \(b=a^c\), we obtain
\[
\begin{aligned}
\log_3(\log_2x)&=7^0=1,\\
\log_2x&=3^1=3,\\
x&=2^3=8.
\end{aligned}
\]
This value satisfies \(x>2\), so all the original logarithms are defined. Therefore
\[
x^{-1/2}=\frac{1}{\sqrt8}
=\frac{1}{2\sqrt2}
=\frac{\sqrt2}{4}.
\]
The positive denominators in choices A through D have squares \(9,12,27,42\), respectively, whereas our denominator has square \(8\). Thus the answer is \(\frac{\sqrt2}{4}\), choice E.
